Working Hours
Standard working hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Employees are expected to maintain punctuality and inform their manager in case of delays. Code of Conduct
Employees must maintain professionalism and respect towards colleagues, clients, and management. Harassment, discrimination, or any form of misconduct will not be tolerated. Dress Code
Business casual attire is required on regular working days.

Formal attire is expected during client meetings and official events. Confidentiality
Employees must protect company data, client information, and trade secrets. Sharing confidential information with unauthorized parties is strictly prohibited. Attendance
Employees must record attendance daily through the company portal. Frequent unexplained absences may lead to disciplinary action.

Casual Leave (CL)
12 days per year. Must be applied for at least 1 day in advance, except in emergencies. Sick Leave (SL)
10 days per year. Medical certificate required for leaves exceeding 3 consecutive days. Earned/Privilege Leave (EL/PL)
15 days per year, accrued monthly. Can be carried forward up to 30 days; excess is encashed at year-end. Maternity Leave
26 weeks as per statutory guidelines. Paternity Leave
10 working days.

Paternity Leave
10 working days. Public Holidays
As per the company's annual holiday calendar (typically 10-12 declared holidays). Leave Application Process
All leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal and approved by the reporting manager.

* The company provides employees with a **work-from-home allowance of ₹5,000 per year**. * The company provides employees with **health insurance coverage** for medical expenses. * Employees are entitled to **paid annual leave and sick leave** as per company policy. * The company provides employees with **learning and development opportunities** to improve their technical skills. * Employees may receive **performance-based increments and bonuses** based on their performance.

* The company provides employees with **training and certification opportunities** based on project requirements. * Employees may have the opportunity to **work with international clients and gain global project exposure**. * The company provides **flexible working arrangements** depending on the project and client requirements. * Employees receive **PF and other statutory benefits** as applicable.

* The company may provide **employee assistance and wellness programs** to support employee well-being. * Employees get opportunities for **career growth and internal role progression**. * The company may organize **team outings, employee engagement activities, and company events**. * Employees may receive **shift allowances or other applicable allowances** depending on their work schedule. * The company provides employees with a **professional and collaborative work environment**.
* Employees can gain **hands-on experience with modern technologies** through real-world projects.
